public class MinHeap {
 private int [] heap = new int[20];
 private int pointer = 1;
 private int curPtr = 0;
 
 public static void main(String [] args) {
 MinHeap minHeap = new MinHeap();
 int [] values = {41, 53, 32, 64, 50, 14, 5, 23, 87, 90};
 
 for(int i : values) {
 minHeap.insert(i);
 }
 
 for(int i : minHeap.heap) {
 System.out.print(i + " ");
 }
 }
 
 
 public void insert(int val) {
 if(pointer == 1) {
 heap[pointer] = val;
 pointer ++;
 return;
 }
 
 curPtr = pointer; pointer ++;
 heap[curPtr] = val;
 percolate(curPtr);

 // swap leaves
 if(curPtr * 2 + 1 <= pointer) {
 if(heap[curPtr * 2] > heap [curPtr * 2 + 1]) {
 swap(curPtr * 2, (curPtr * 2 + 1));
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void percolate(int pointer) {
 boolean swapped = false;
 while(heap[curPtr] <= heap[curPtr/2]) {
 swap(curPtr, curPtr/2);
 swapped = true;
 }

 if(swapped) {
 curPtr = curPtr/2 == 0 ? 1 : curPtr / 2;
 }
 
 }
 
 
 private void swap(int from, int to) {
 int temp = heap[from];
 heap[from] = heap[to];
 heap[to] = temp;
 
 curPtr = to;
 }
}
